name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Heat vegetable stock in a saucepan and keep it barely simmering. Slice mushrooms and finely chop onion and garlic.
Brown mushrooms in olive oil over medium-high heat for 7 minutes; remove. Add half the butter and soften onion and garlic.
Add unwashed rice and stir for 2 minutes. Add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until mostly absorbed before adding more.
Continue for 18–22 minutes until rice is creamy with a slight bite. Fold in mushrooms, salt and pepper; add stock as needed for a flowing texture.
Remove from heat and stir in remaining butter, grated vegetarian hard cheese and parsley. Serve immediately on warm plates.
tips: Use vegetarian stock and cheese; ordinary Parmesan may contain animal rennet.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
